Equipping multiple 2|3 Root of Nightmares weapons grants the following benefits:
• 3.33% | 10% increased damage against <pve The Dread, Lucent Hive, and Nezarec />
• 10 | 20 Handling
• 0 | 20 Reload Speed
• 5% decreased Reload Animation Duration

/*Affected enemies:
• The Dread, Lucent Hive, and Nezarec
• Enemy Players with their Super (or Transcendence?) active*/
